From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + suggested next steps (Dedicated / Private option)

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: EdgeAI needs predictable inference latency at scale for your customer-facing real-time features, and you have regulatory constraints around data residency and audit logging for EU customers.
- Recommended path: Evaluate Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for initial production, with the option to migrate to a Private (VPC/on-prem) control plane if you need full network isolation.
- Immediate asks from your side: a) confirmation that procurement will review a dedicated capacity contract, b) any specific compliance docs (SOC 2, data retention TTLs) we should include in an NDA/procurement packet, and c) an expected timeline for Q3 launch if you proceed.

I attached a short Private deployment one-pager and a draft SOW template to speed procurement reviews. Suggested next steps:
1) If procurement is involved, can you intro them and we’ll send contract precedents?
2) Let’s schedule a 30-min technical follow-up with Rishi to walk through network/VPC architectures and any on-prem constraints — are mornings (9–11 PT) better this week?
3) If timeline is high priority, we can prepare a cost/latency estimate for both Dedicated and Private options.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll send a brief follow-up mid-week to check timing — I know you’re juggling a few things.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia — quick tech note following Vanessa’s recap: 

- Audit logs & retention: Redwood Private exposes request-level audit logs via a secured log stream (TLS) and also offers a managed S3 export for longer-term retention. For Private/VPC installs the logs remain in your VPC or on-prem storage; for Dedicated we provide an encrypted export path to your S3. Retention policies are configurable per-tenant; common presets are 30/90/365 days.
- Network/VPC options: we support customer-managed VPC peering, private endpoints with strict CIDR allow-lists, and an optional on-prem appliance for fully air-gapped inference (additional ops support required).
- Next steps: I can prepare a 1-page tech note that maps these options to your compliance checklist and call out any expected work on your side (routing, firewall rules, KMS access).

If you confirm the 29 Jul slot at 10:00 PT, I’ll prepare that note and share the SOC 2 excerpt for procurement.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
